docs: Validate links/authority references and run git diff --check.
python: Run focused Python unit tests plus malformed-input and deterministic-rerun cases.
php: Run focused Pest tests, PHPStan at project max level, and Pint/check for touched PHP.
ts: Run TypeScript type-check, relevant unit/component tests and build when shared frontend code changes.
db: Test constraints/transactions against PostgreSQL, including representative invalid rows.
migration: Prove fresh migration and upgrade from the previous real schema; rollback/forward-fix where practical.
api: Test authenticated/unauthenticated/unauthorized, validation, not-found and failure responses.
ui: Test loading, empty, error, disabled and responsive states; use real references when specified.
a11y: Test keyboard/focus and relevant accessibility; include TV/remote focus where applicable.
e2e: Run representative browser/client E2E through the real public boundary.
contract: Run schema/contract compatibility checks and reject silent breaking changes.
integration: Run the smallest real integration path across touched boundaries, including failure recovery.
security: Add negative/adversarial tests for authorization, malformed input, secrets/privacy leakage and unsafe fallbacks.
adult: Test locked/unlocked behavior and zero existence/data leakage through all relevant surfaces.
adapter: Use versioned fixtures; test auth, pagination, malformed responses, unsupported capabilities, timeout/outage and resync.
files: Use temp fixtures; test rename/move/retry/duplicate behavior and prove originals stay safe.
jobs: Test idempotency, duplicate execution, retry/backoff, cancellation, crash/restart and checkpoints.
realtime: Test reconnect, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, stale state and realtime authorization.
playback: Test direct play/remux/transcode or equivalent decisions, sessions, tracks, progress and degraded states.
perf: Measure relevant query count/latency/memory/throughput on representative bounded fixtures.
rust: Run cargo test plus clippy/format and native failure-boundary tests when applicable.
ai: Test provider absence, model/version/provenance, resource limits and privacy boundaries.
release: Test clean install, upgrade, rollback/forward-fix, artifact integrity and compatibility metadata.
